services.title: What we do
services.intro: One team from the first conversation to the final post, so your strategy and your content never drift apart.

items.title: Communication strategy
items.text: Plans that tie every message to a goal, an audience and a channel, with a way to measure what worked.

items.title: Brand positioning
items.text: We define what you stand for, how you sound and why people should care, then put it in writing your team can use.

items.title: Storytelling and content
items.text: Narratives, scripts, articles, speeches and campaigns built around the people and moments that make your work real.

items.title: Creative execution
items.text: Design, photography, video and social content produced to the same standard across print and digital.

items.title: Podcast and media production
items.text: From concept and guest booking to recording, editing and distribution. The Up Close is our flagship show.

items.title: Media relations and events
items.text: Press engagement, launches and panels planned so the right people hear your story at the right time.

items.title: The Up Close with Davis Higiro
items.summary: A conversation series about the people behind remarkable journeys.
items.challenge: Create a podcast that feels personal and credible enough to bring leaders to the table, and distinctive enough to stand out in a crowded feed.
items.approach: We built the full identity: microphone wordmark, navy and gold palette, studio set, guest artwork templates and a weekly release workflow across YouTube, Spotify and social.
items.result: A recognisable show brand with a consistent look across every episode, guest card and clip.

items.title: Kommz Hub brand identity
items.summary: Our own identity: a framed KH monogram, a strict monochrome palette and a voice built on clarity.
items.imageAlt: Kommz Hub letterhead, business cards and phone
items.challenge: Give a young communications company an identity that looks established from day one and works in print, digital and on merchandise.
items.approach: A geometric KH monogram, Geist and Syne typography, a black, white and mist palette, and a full guideline covering logo use, imagery and applications.
items.result: One consistent system across stationery, social media and branded merchandise.

items.title: Kommz Hub social media launch
items.summary: Launch content and profile system for Instagram and stories.
items.imageAlt: Three phone screens showing Kommz Hub stories
items.challenge: Introduce a new name and make people remember it within a few posts.
items.approach: Short typographic statements, a repeating wordmark pattern and documentary photography, organised into highlights for Hub, Influence, Work and Process.
items.result: A ready-to-run content system the team can extend every week.
